The hardest thing about living with other people is watching my mom cry because the people would yell at my mom because we did not have any money and they would yell at us to get out. It hurt me to see my mom hurting and I couldn't do much to help her. I am always trying to help my younger sister and brother to decrease my mom's load when I come home from school. Mom has enough to do so I try to play with them and keep them happy. So I do that at home and maybe not so much homework.
